definition_en: the early part of the day, from sunrise until noon
core_image: 天刚亮，光从窗边慢慢铺进屋里
scene: 窗外的鸟每天早晨都在枝头唱歌。 The birds outside the window sing every morning on the branch.
sceneCN: 这里 morning 是「早晨」（第 1 个义项：一天中日出前后的一段时间）；句意：窗外的鸟每天早晨都在枝头唱歌。

senses.title: The early part of the day
senses.definition: the early part of the day, from sunrise until about noon
senses.definitionCN: 一天中从日出到中午前后的一段时间
senses.example: I get up early in the morning.
senses.why: Light returns and the world wakes, so the word names the stretch of day that follows the dark.
senses.whyCN: 光回来了，世界醒来，于是这个词命名黑暗之后的那一段白昼。

senses.title: The whole forenoon
senses.definition: the time before noon, including the later part of the forenoon
senses.definitionCN: 中午之前的时间，包括上午后半段
senses.example: The meeting lasted all morning.
senses.why: Morning stretches from first light to noon, so it can cover the whole block of time before lunch.
senses.whyCN: morning 从第一缕光延伸到正午，因此可以涵盖午饭前的整段时间。

senses.title: A spoken greeting
senses.definition: a short greeting used in the morning
senses.example: Morning, everyone!
senses.why: The name of the time becomes a greeting, as if the speaker were handing over the morning itself.
senses.whyCN: 时间的名字变成问候语，仿佛说话人把整个早晨递了过去。

intro.en: Morning is built on an old Germanic word for the dawn and has named the early day for centuries.
intro.cn: morning 建立在一个古老的日耳曼语「黎明」词上，数百年来一直指清晨。

items.en: The ancestor form murgana refers to the morning.
items.cn: 祖语形式 murgana 指早晨。

items.en: Morgen means morning, and the word is already common.
items.cn: morgen 意为早晨，这个词当时已很常用。

items.en: The ending -ing is added and the form becomes morning.
items.cn: 中古英语中加上词尾 -ing，形成 morning。

items.en: Good morning becomes the standard polite greeting.
items.cn: 近代早期，good morning 成为标准的礼貌问候。

items.en: Morning still means the hours before noon.
items.cn: 现代英语中，morning 仍指正午之前的时段。

note.en: Morning is the early day, dawn is the first light, and mourning is a sad homophone.
note.cn: morning 是清晨时段，dawn 是第一缕光，mourning 是同音的「哀悼」。

definition_en: a person who works on a farm, owns one, or raises animals
core_image: 农夫戴着草帽在田里弯腰除草，手上沾着泥土

senses.title: A farm worker
senses.definition: a person who works on a farm
senses.example: The farmer works in the field all day.

senses.whyCN: farmer 是 farm 加 -er，即「种地的人」；这个后缀由工作指出人，正如 teacher、driver。

senses.exampleCN: 这位农场主拥有土地和谷仓。

senses.whyCN: 因为种地的人往往也持有土地，同一个词也指农场的主人或经营者。

senses.title: A raiser of one animal
senses.definition: a person who raises one kind of animal
senses.definitionCN: 专门饲养一种动物的人
senses.example: Her uncle is a pig farmer.
senses.why: English compounds farmer with the animal or crop, naming the person by what he raises, as in pig farmer or dairy farmer.
senses.whyCN: 英语让 farmer 与动物或作物组合，用所养的东西来指人，如 pig farmer、dairy farmer。

senses.whyCN: 接近夏至，白昼拖得很晚，季节显得开阔。

senses.exampleCN: 收到那封信后他情绪低落。

senses.exampleCN: 大海的蔚蓝让我们惊叹。
senses.why: Writers name the whole by its colour, so the blue can stand for the sky or the sea without naming either object.
senses.whyCN: 作家用颜色代指整体，所以 the blue 不用点明对象，就能指天空或大海。

definition_en: to come together with someone, or to satisfy a need or a standard
core_image: 校门口两个孩子迎面撞见，书包带子晃了一下
scene: 校门口两个孩子迎面撞见，书包带子晃了一下。 I met my teacher on the way home.
sceneCN: 这里 meet 是「遇见」（第 01 个义项）；句意是我在回家路上遇到了老师。

senses.title: To come together with someone by chance or by plan
senses.definition: To come together with someone by chance or by plan
senses.example: I met my teacher on the way home.
senses.exampleCN: 我在回家路上遇到了老师。
senses.why: Old English metan meant to come upon; a chance meeting and an arranged one share the same picture of two paths crossing.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 metan 意为碰见；偶遇与约见都共享两条路交叉的同一画面。

senses.title: To satisfy a need or a standard
senses.definition: To satisfy a need or a standard
senses.example: The school meets the safety rules.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学校符合安全规定。
senses.why: A meeting of two things can also mean a demand and a supply arriving together, so meet took the sense of satisfying.
senses.whyCN: 两样东西相遇也可指需求与供给恰好碰头，于是 meet 有了满足之义。

senses.title: A gathering for sports competitions
senses.definition: A gathering for sports competitions
senses.example: Our school held a sports meet in May.
senses.exampleCN: 我们学校五月举办了运动会。
senses.why: In British English a meet is a gathering for sport, a short name for the meeting of competitors.
senses.whyCN: 英式英语中 meet 指运动集会，是参赛者相聚的简称。
